invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator, either from Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() or as the result of IOUtils.runMerge.
If recordItr is empty, the returned iterator yields one empty list (so hasNext() true); otherwise, IOUtils.runMerge should return a non-empty iterator.
A non-empty recordItr implies a merge, which requires a non-null fileId to properly produce an update handle and a result.
partitionPath is always used to determine the update handle and is required to construct a valid result.
